svg.desc: Thinkle, Dice Chess. AI-generated with Recraft (recraftv4_1_vector) for Fortemate on 2026-10-04; the forehead, the background and the faces of the die recoloured, the pips of the die redrawn as a real die's, and the tip of a finger, drawn apart from it, joined to it by tools/portraits.py. The unedited original, with the C2PA manifest Recraft embedded, is source/recraft/thinkle.svg in fortemate/dicechess-assets.
